name: mobimatter
description: Generates MobiMatter eSIM integration code into your project — catalogue sync, ordering, top-ups, replacements, eSIM QR/LPA retrieval, usage checks and completion webhooks — built against the live API contract at docs.mobimatter.com.

interface.shortDescription: Build eSIM ordering and provisioning into your app
interface.longDescription: Adds MobiMatter's eSIM API to your project: browse the plan catalogue, create orders, provision eSIMs, issue top-ups and replacements, fetch QR codes and LPA activation strings, check data usage, and handle order webhooks. Built against the live API contract at docs.mobimatter.com.
defaultPrompt: Add MobiMatter eSIM plan browsing to this app.
Create a MobiMatter order and return the eSIM QR code.
